findings.value: A pub in Coate Street, Bethnal Green, with a gig room in its basement below the ground-floor bar. Dice describes the building as historically a movie theatre and music hall, and Londonist says its live entertainment has ranged from punk in the 70s to cabaret in the 90s.

evidence.quote: Historically a movie theatre & music hall
punk in the 70s, disco in the 80s, cabaret in the 90s

findings.value: Gigs in the basement music room, with karaoke and quiz nights listed for the pub on Dice.

notes: Searched once; the press results were Time Out (2015-03-25) and Londonist (last updated 2015-05). Both are over five years old, so they back only the history in the summary, not crowd or music (Time Out's 'mostly in their mid-twenties' and Londonist's 'young trendies' are not used). The venue's own site is not reachable: sebrightarms.co.uk returns robots.txt unreachable, so it was not read, and no website is proposed. Dice's venue page lists events on sale to 12 November 2026, so the venue appears open; no closing news found. No current source names a music style for the venue.
